extraction.name: EgoLife Dataset
extraction.description: A comprehensive 300-hour egocentric, interpersonal, multiview, and multimodal daily life dataset with intensive annotation.
extraction.creator: The EgoLife Team
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Six participants lived together for one week, continuously recording their daily activities using AI glasses for multimodal egocentric video capture, along with synchronized third-person-view video references.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Multimodal egocentric videos from Meta Aria glasses, third-person perspectives from GoPro cameras, and spatial/motion data from millimeter-wave radars.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: A rigorous data cleaning process was implemented to ensure synchronization, participant privacy, and readiness for annotation and data release. All identifiable faces and sensitive license plates were blurred, and audio containing sensitive topics was muted.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Videos were split into 5-minute clips and slowed to 0.8x speed, allowing annotators to provide continuous narrations. These were converted to text, merged into coherent sentences using GPT-4o-mini, and expanded into visual-audio captions summarized by GPT-4o, which were then verified by human annotators.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: A video editing software with dubbing functions (Capcut)
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Speech recognition, diarization algorithm, GPT-4o-mini, and GPT-4o
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset and models could support daily activities and improve quality of life, especially for individuals needing consistent support, such as the elderly or those with cognitive challenges.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset has a narrow setting, sacrificing some generalizability such as being limited to a single language and scenario.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training EgoGPT and automatically generating QA candidates.

inLanguage.evidence: The primary language of the EgoLife dataset is Chinese1. All the annotations (transcripts, captions, QAs) are primarily in Chinese and translated into English.

rai:dataCollection.evidence: ...we conducted a comprehensive data collection study where six participants lived together for one week, continuously recording their daily activities—including discussions, shopping, cooking, socializing, and entertainment—using AI glasses for multimodal egocentric video capture, along with synchronized thirdperson-view video references.

rai:dataCollectionType.evidence: Each participant wore Meta Aria glasses [ 1] and captured multimodal egocentric videos. To enhance the dataset with third-person perspectives, 15 strategically placed GoPro cameras recorded the participants’ activities from multiple angles.

rai:dataCollectionRawData.evidence: Each participant wore Meta Aria glasses [ 1] and captured multimodal egocentric videos. To enhance the dataset with third-person perspectives, 15 strategically placed GoPro cameras recorded the participants’ activities from multiple angles. Additionally, millimeter-wave radars provided spatial and motion data...

rai:dataCollectionTimeframe.evidence: The EgoLife dataset was collected over a sevenday period with six volunteers residing in a custom-designed environment, called the EgoHouse

rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol.evidence: A rigorous data cleaning process was implemented to ensure synchronization, participant privacy, and readiness for annotation and data release... All identifiable faces and sensitive license plates were blurred, and audio containing sensitive topics was muted.

rai:dataAnnotationProtocol.evidence: We split all the videos into 5-minute clips, which were slowed to 0.8 ×speed, allowing annotators to provide continuous, detailed narrations by talking without pauses for high information density... Using GPT-4o-mini, we merged related phrases into 25K “merged captions,” forming coherent sentences aligned with specific video segments. These captions were then expanded by pairing them with representative frames (sampled at 1 FPS) and corresponding transcripts, summarized by GPT-4o.

rai:dataAnnotationPlatform.evidence: The captioning tool is a video editing software with dubbing functions [ 92].

rai:machineAnnotationTools.evidence: ...applying speech recognition [ 90] to generate initial timestamped transcripts. Using an open-source diarization algorithm [ 91], we differentiated the speakers... Using GPT-4o-mini, we merged related phrases into 25K “merged captions,”... summarized by GPT-4o.

rai:dataSocialImpact.evidence: By enabling AI to understand long-term, egocentric perspectives, EgoButler could support daily activities, personal organization, and contextual reminders, improving quality of life, especially for individuals needing consistent support, such as the elderly or those with cognitive challenges.

rai:dataLimitations.evidence: As the first step toward a realistic egocentric life assistant, we intentionally started with a narrow setting to build a strong foundation, sacrificing some generalizability (e.g., single language/scenario).

rai:dataUseCases.evidence: These captions serve two main purposes: training EgoGPT and automatically generating QA candidates for the next section.
